notes: Ten interaction episodes are identified. The two independently hinged pantry-cabinet leaves are reported separately because each is a distinct movable part; their rapid opening and partly obscured closing make their individual timings less certain. The living-room-to-bedroom door closure is inferred from the change in its visible orientation after the camera turns away.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living/dining area, utility and laundry closets, and a bedroom. The user sequentially opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, cabinet doors, closet doors, and an interior room door.
